description:
Find drugs that significantly affect a specific gene.
Data: Tahoe-100M pseudobulk differential expression (prepared by tools/prepare_tahoe.py) · table de_permissive — one record = one gene's DESeq2 contrast for one drug at one concentration in one cell line on one plate (replicate wells pooled).
Key: drug, concentration, concentration_unit, Cell_ID_DepMap, plate, gene_name.
Arguments: gene_name accepts tahoe gene or ensembl gene or hgnc symbol (resolved; unknown -> error); cell_line_filter accepts depmap cell line (resolved; unknown -> error); top_n counts drugs, not rows.
Results: ranked by log2FoldChange desc_abs (verified by the harness); `_vbt.total` counts all matches; `_vbt.grains.gene` counts genes; `_vbt.grains.drug` counts drugs; `_vbt.grains.cell_line` counts cell_lines; `_vbt.grains.drug_dose` counts drug_doses; `_vbt.grains.contrast` counts contrasts.
Rows with unknown log2FoldChange, padj are excluded and counted in `_vbt.excluded_unknown`.
padj is adjusted within one drug, concentration, concentration_unit, Cell_ID_DepMap, plate family.
Missing rows are censored (padj >= 0.1): not significant or not tested.…

cell_line_filter.description: Accepts depmap_cell_line; resolved to one depmap_cell_line (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

concentration.description: Results are per concentration; pass one value, or the call fails with incomplete_key when several apply.

concentration_unit.description: Results are per concentration_unit; pass one value, or the call fails with incomplete_key when several apply.

gene_name.description: Accepts tahoe_gene, ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol; resolved to one tahoe_gene (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

max_padj.description: Keeps rows with padj <= this value; unknown values never pass. Defaults to 0.1; pass null for no restriction.

min_abs_log2fc.description: Keeps rows with log2FoldChange |x| > this value (compared on the absolute value); unknown values never pass. Defaults to 0.5; pass null for no restriction.

plate.description: Results are listed per plate; pass one value to restrict them.
